# Scale By Tech

> > Scale By Tech teaches vibe coding and microapp development through a Skool community, helping builders ship automation tools in 48 hours using no-code platforms like n8n, Make.com, and Airtable.

Scale By Tech is a learning platform and community focused on rapid microapp development and business automation. The site offers free resources, a manifesto on vibe coding philosophy, and membership access to courses and templates for building practical tools quickly.

## Key Topics

- Microapps
- Vibe Coding
- No-code automation
- Skool community
- n8n workflows
- Make.com
- Airtable
- Blog Booster Blueprint
- HARO outreach
- SEO optimization
- Business scaling
- 48-hour shipping
- MicroApp.live
- DIY implementation
- Automation tools
